column1: # Chinese business-name words (curated 2026-11-10), checked against the words GLEIF's Chinese names
# use most (科技, 贸易, 实业, 商贸, 进出口, 投资管理, 生物科技). A mainland name is
# place + trade name (字号) + trade + form, with no spaces: 上海华信科技有限公司 (the 2021
# Regulations on Enterprise Name Registration). The trade name is two characters, coined here from
# the characters such names favour. Small shops use the owner's surname + 记. Each word carries its
# pinyin after "=", used for domains. place: per country; surname: the commonest surnames, as
# name-generator's lists are in Latin script. Traditional characters for TW, HK and MO are made at
# build time from a fixed table (prepare_tables.py). Columns as in en.tsv.
